messages:
ana: heads-up — noticed the Ruby streaming client emits a different event envelope than Go/JS when using structured streaming. downstream parser in sampleapp fails intermittently.

sam_k: hmm, can you paste an example payload?

ana: here's a minimal reproduced chunk — Ruby sends an outer `event` wrapper, others send bare `type`/`data` fields. sampleapp expects the latter so it chokes:```
{"event": {"type":"token","data":{"access_token":"abc"}}}
vs
{"type":"token","data":{"access_token":"abc"}}
```

louis: thanks, that explains the 422s we saw in the demo yesterday. @ana did you hit this on 0.8.x or main?

ana: main — I bisected to the streaming marshaller in `lib/redwood/stream.rb` after a small refactor (PR 528). I can open a revert PR or add a compatibility flag.

sam_k: let's avoid a revert if possible. can we make the parser in sampleapp more tolerant and add a unit test for both envelope shapes? also add a quick integration test to the ruby-sdk to assert parity with the js-sdk mock.

louis: agree. can you draft a tiny PR that: 1) adds tolerant parsing in sampleapp, 2) updates ruby-sdk streaming tests to cover both shapes, and 3) a short note in changelog about the envelope change?

ana: will do. rough plan: add `parse_event(payload)` that checks if `payload["event"]` exists then unwraps, otherwise use as-is. push in a branch and ping for review.

maya: fwiw, I think the original intent of wrapping was to allow metadata later (trace id), but we shouldn't break consumers. maybe add `stream_envelope: :compatible` option on client so users can opt into the new shape after we announce it.

louis: that's a good compromise. add the option but default to compatible mode for one release, mention deprecation plan in the changelog.

ci-bot: build passed for branch `ana/stream-envelope-fix` (job #4821) :white_check_mark:

sam_k: pinging @louis for review once the PR is up. try to keep the PR < 30 LOC so it lands quickly — it's a regression.

ana: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ruby-sdk/pull/534 — small wrapper + tests + CHANGELOG entry. I've left a TODO to remove default later.

louis: reviewing now. if green CI and minimal docs, we can backport to 0.8.x as a patch.

sam_k: thanks for catching it early. once merged, let's add a tiny note to the sampleapp README about the envelope and the compatibility flag. :thumbsup:

ana: will follow up with a patch backport and a short blurb. thanks all.
